source_caption_text:
Lil Durk really wanted King Von to do well 🥹💔

Lil Durk and King Von shared a deep personal, professional, and brotherly connection rooted in their shared upbringing on the South Side of Chicago. They grew up around the same circles and communities, such as Parkway Gardens (O-Block), which built a strong foundation of trust and loyalty long before either gained widespread fame. Their bond was heavily tied to their shared lived experiences and street background.

In terms of their music careers, Lil Durk played a pivotal role in King Von’s rise as an artist. After Von was released from prison, Durk recognized his potential and storytelling talent, signing him to his record label, Only The Family (OTF). Durk brought Von onto large tours, provided studio space, and collaborated with him on numerous hit tracks. Von rapidly built a major career through Durk’s backing and his own distinct storytelling style. Beyond music, the two were often seen together, frequently referring to each other as family or “twins”.

Following King Von’s death in November 2020, Lil Durk consistently honored his legacy through music, social media tributes, and concert moments, keeping Von’s memory central to the OTF movement.
